description: This file defines a cost calculator function for Vertex AI image generation, utilizing the litellm library and a specific ImageResponse type to compute costs based on the number of images generated.

classes.name: ImageResponse
classes.description: A type imported from litellm.types.utils representing the structure of image response data.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: ImageResponse, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of image generation based on model information and the number of images in the response.
